title: José Rizal's birth chart
metaDescription: José Rizal's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 27.8° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the ten placements whose signs are settled, cardinal leads with four. The cardinal signs begin things; a chart weighted there treats every stall as a starting gun.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 27.8° of Gemini is the Sun's exact seat — third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Saturn in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Mercury holds 22.3° Cancer, Venus holds 8.2° Cancer, Mars holds 20.0° Cancer — in the old shorthand, thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Venus and Pluto: 1.8° from an exact sextile. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, Mercury conjunction Mars at 2.3°, and the Sun square Neptune at 3.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Jupiter makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags two placements in this chart. The Moon in Scorpio at 11.3° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Cancer at 20.0° is in fall. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in water, 2 in air, 2 in fire, 2 in earth by element, 4 cardinal, 3 mutable, 3 fixed by modality. Not one planet was retrograde, so the whole chart reads in direct motion.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.6° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 11.3°.
